monsters.description:
A common dungeon snake, a species of troglodytic reptile commonly found in subterranean spaces.

Max HP: ~11      Will: +          AC: +          EV: +++                        
Threat: High    Class: Natural  Size: V. Small  Int: Animal     
Speed: 130% (swim: 216%) (normally travels faster than you)

It is resistant to drowning.
It is cold-blooded and may be slowed by cold attacks.
It can travel through water.
